$comment: The note fields K2 Horizon may propose from one dictated transcript (FR-11), sent to llama-server as the response format, so the model can't answer in any other shape (the sidecar's prompt.py strips $schema and $comment first). History, Assessment and Plan only: there is no field for orders or allergies (FR-14). Each field is a value and the passages of the transcript it came from, copied word for word; an empty value with no sources means the transcript said nothing for that field. Changing this file needs line-by-line human review (AGENTS.md) and a new eval run (eval/README.md).
